title: Uniform accessible injective factorizations of simplicial-category diagrams
statement:
Fix a Grothendieck universe $\mathcal U$. Let $D$ be a $\mathcal U$-small ordinary category. Small simplicial categories, their Dwyer--Kan model structure and its generating maps have the meanings in [lem-coef-simplicial-interval-lifting], [lem-coef-simplicial-interval-cell-stability] and [lem-coef-simplicial-localization-comparison-calculus]. For a universe $\mathcal V$ containing $\mathcal U$ (or equal to it), write $\mathrm{sCat}_{\mathcal V}$ for simplicial categories whose objects and mapping simplicial sets are $\mathcal V$-small. Equip $\operatorname{Fun}(D,\mathrm{sCat}_{\mathcal V})$ with the injective model structure of [lem-coef-combinatorial-injective-diagram-model]: weak equivalences and cofibrations are objectwise, and fibrations lift against all objectwise trivial cofibrations.

There is an infinite regular cardinal $\delta\in\mathcal U$, depending only on $D$ and the fixed Kan-model/Bergner generating data, with the following property. In every such $\mathcal V$ the two injective weak factorization systems have functorial factorizations
$$H\xrightarrow{i_f}E^c_{D,\mathcal V}(f)\xrightarrow{p_f}H',\qquad H\xrightarrow{j_f}E^f_{D,\mathcal V}(f)\xrightarrow{q_f}H'$$
of every arrow $f:H\to H'$, where $i_f$ is an injective cofibration, $p_f$ an injective trivial fibration, $j_f$ an injective trivial cofibration, and $q_f$ an injective fibration. Both middle-object functors preserve pointwise colimits indexed by every $\mathcal V$-small $\delta$-filtered ordinary category. Here regular means that a union of fewer than $\delta$ sets of size less than $\delta$ has size less than $\delta$, and filtered means that every diagram with fewer than $\delta$ morphisms admits a cocone. Functorial means that every commuting square between arrows induces a map of factorizations, compatibly with identities and composition. For an inclusion $\mathcal V\subseteq\mathcal V'$, the factorizations can be chosen with natural isomorphisms $\iota E^e_{D,\mathcal V}\cong E^e_{D,\mathcal V'}\iota$ for $e=c,f$, compatible with both factor maps, where $\iota$ includes the smaller diagrams into the larger ones. The same cardinal $\delta$ works in every $\mathcal V$. This includes $D=\{*\}$, when these are the ordinary Bergner factorizations.

source.place: Proposition A.1.2.5(2), printed pp.790-791; Proposition A.2.8.2 and Lemma A.2.8.3, printed pp.830-831; the bounded-generator proof of Lemma A.3.3.3, printed pp.878-884, specialized to ordinary diagrams of Bergner simplicial categories. The universe-independent bound is the replacement input asserted in the proof of Corollary A.3.6.18, printed p.905. Read online 2026-10-17; archival HTT WANTED. No Stacks tag states this enriched-model-theoretic replacement result.
